paite: TOUPA, ka hon sam hi, ka kiang ah hong pai meng inla, ka hon sap in ka aw ah bil na doh in.
heading: David La / Nitaklam Thumna
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

paite: Ka thumna gimnamtui bang in na ma ah hihkhiak in om henla; ka khut zak nitaklam kithoihna bang in om hen.
english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka kam bul ah vengmi tusak inla; ka muk kongkhak veng in.
english: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

paite: Gilou-salou thil hihkhialmi te hih bang in, thil hoih lou lam ah ka lungtang kiheisak ke'nla; aneklimte uh hon nesak ke'n.
english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

paite: Midiktat in hon sat hen, migitna ahi ding; hon taihilh hen; thau manpha ahi ding a, migilou-salou in ka lutang thaunilh ngei kei hen, anasep giloute hua in ka thum gige hi.
english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

paite: Amau mohpaih dingte kiang a piakkhiak ahih chiang un, TOUPA thu adik chih athei ding uh.
english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

paite: Mi'n lei aleh a, ahihzan bang in aguhte uh han gong ah thehdalh in a-om ding.
english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian aw, ka mit in nang lama-en nak a; nangmah ah ka muanna ka nga a; ka hinna vuaktang in nuse ke'n.
english: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

paite: Ka awkna ding a athangkam lak uah hon hum in, thil hihkhialte thang lak ah.
english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

paite: Kei ka suakta ding a, migilou-salou amau len ah awk uhen.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.
